# Merge project files from a project terminal back into the project folder ## What to build A project terminal works in `.projects/

/.gm-worktrees/`, a git worktree of the project folder's own repo on branch `gm-term/`. Edits there to `project.json`, `CLAUDE.md`, specs and similar files count as work, but the project repo has no remote, so there is nothing to open a PR against. This slice adds **Merge project files**. It commits the worktree's uncommitted project changes, then merges `gm-term/` into the project folder's checked-out branch: fast-forward when possible, otherwise `git merge --no-edit`. On a conflict it aborts cleanly, reports the files, and leaves everything as it was. After a successful merge, the project repo no longer counts as work when closing. It is offered in the project close dialog and on kept project worktrees in the sidebar. The spec is `docs/prd/project-terminal-worktrees.md` (Decisions and Requirements → "Git helpers", "API"). Already in the codebase: - the `projectWorktrees[wid]` store record (`{ projectId, path, branch, base, title, createdAt, terminalId?, kept?, mergedAt?, repos }`); - `projectWorktreeState(rec)` / `projectHasWork` in `apps/graph-manager/src/server/worktrees.ts`; - `projectWorktreeOfTerminal(ctx, terminalId)` and the kept project worktree routes (`GET/DELETE /api/projects/:id/worktrees[/:wid]`) in `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/terminals.ts`; - the web pieces `ProjectWorktreeCloseDialog` (`apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/WorktreeClose.tsx`) and the kept-project rows in `TerminalSidebar.tsx` (`kept-project-worktree`). ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/worktrees.ts` — `git()`, `worktreeState`, `WorktreeError`, `projectWorktreeState`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/worktree-pr.ts` (lines 120–135) — how a worktree's changes are committed with a fallback identity: ```ts const email = await execa("git", ["config", "user.email"], { cwd: rec.path, reject: false }); const identity = String(email.stdout ?? "").trim() === "" ? ["-c", "user.name=graph-manager", "-c", "user.email=graph-manager@localhost"] : []; await run([...identity, "commit", "-q", "-m", title, "-m", body], rec.path); ``` - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/projects.ts` — `projectDirOf`. The project repo is created with `user.name graph-manager` when the machine has no identity. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/terminals.ts` — the project-terminal DELETE handler (409 `needsChoice` with `project`/`repos`) and the kept project worktree routes. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/WorktreeClose.tsx` — `ProjectWorktreeCloseDialog`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/TerminalSidebar.tsx` — the kept project rows. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Terminals.tsx` — `closingProject` state, `loadKept`, `setError`, `useToast`. ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/worktrees.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `export async function mergeProjectFiles(projectDir: string, rec: ProjectWorktreeRecord): Promise<{ fastForward: boolean }>`: 1. If `git status --porcelain` in `projectDir` is non-empty → `WorktreeError(409, "the project folder has uncommitted changes")`. 2. If the worktree (`rec.path`) is dirty → `git add -A -- .` then commit (identity fallback as above) with message `gm: project files from `. 3. In `projectDir`, run `git merge --ff-only `. On success → `{ fastForward: true }`. 4. Otherwise run `git merge --no-edit `. On success → `{ fastForward: false }`. 5. Otherwise collect the conflicting files with `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U`, run `git merge --abort`, and throw `WorktreeError(409, "merge conflict", { files })`. - Afterwards, update `rec.base` to the worktree's `HEAD`, so `projectWorktreeState` reports `project: {0,0}`. The caller saves it to the store, along with `mergedAt`. - **GOTCHA**: `repos/` is gitignored in the project repo; never `git add` it. `-A -- .` respects `.gitignore`. - **GOTCHA**: an error that is not a conflict (for example a detached HEAD in `projectDir`) → `WorktreeError(409, )`, after `git merge --abort` when `MERGE_HEAD` exists. ### ADD routes in `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/terminals.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `POST /api/terminals/:id/merge-project`, using `projectWorktreeOfTerminal`; a terminal without one → 404 `the terminal has no project worktree`. Also `POST /api/projects/:id/worktrees/:wid/merge-project` (record of that project; otherwise 404 `worktree not found`). Both: - call `mergeProjectFiles(projectDirOf(config.workspacesDir, rec.projectId), rec)`; - save `base` and `mergedAt` in the store; - answer 200 `{ merged: true, fastForward }`, or `WorktreeError` → `reply.code(err.status).send({ error: err.message, ...err.extra })`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck` ### UPDATE web: `WorktreeClose.tsx`, `Terminals.tsx`, `TerminalSidebar.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT**: `ProjectWorktreeCloseDialog` gets an optional `onMergeProject?: () => Promise` and a **Merge project files** button (`data-testid="close-merge-project"`), shown when `work.project.dirty + work.project.ahead > 0`. - On click it calls `onMergeProject`. On success, the "Project files" row reads "merged" and the button disappears. - On a 409 conflict it shows `

Merge conflict in: a.md, b.md. The worktree stays; resolve it in a terminal on it.

`, using `ApiError.body.files`. - Other errors show their message. - **IMPLEMENT**: in `Terminals.tsx`, wire `onMergeProject` to `POST /api/terminals//merge-project` for the closing terminal. After success, set the closing work's `project` to `{ dirty: 0, ahead: 0 }`. - **IMPLEMENT**: in `TerminalSidebar.tsx`, kept project rows with project work get a **Merge project files** button (`kept-project-merge`) → `POST /api/projects//worktrees//merge-project`. Success → `toast.show({ tone: "ok", text: "Merged project files" })` and `loadKept()`. Conflict → `toast.show({ tone: "bad", text: "Merge conflict in: …" })`. ### Tests - **IMPLEMENT** in `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/terminals.test.ts`, with a project with one committed repo: 1. Open a project terminal and edit `CLAUDE.md` (a new file) in the worktree. `POST /api/terminals//merge-project` → 200 `{ merged: true, fastForward: true }`, `git log -1 --format=%s` in `.projects/billing` = `gm: project files from `, and `.projects/billing/CLAUDE.md` exists. Closing now → 204 (no work left). 2. Conflict: commit a change to `project.json`'s `name` field directly in `.projects/billing`, and a different change to the same line in the worktree. merge-project → 409 `{ error: "merge conflict", files: ["project.json"] }`. `git status --porcelain` in `.projects/billing` is empty and `.git/MERGE_HEAD` does not exist. The worktree still exists. 3. A dirty `.projects/billing` → 409 `the project folder has uncommitted changes`. - **IMPLEMENT** in `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Terminals.test.tsx`: the close dialog shows **Merge project files** when project work > 0, and success hides it. A 409 with `files` shows `close-merge-error` listing them. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/terminals.test.ts src/web/pages/Terminals.test.tsx` ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `POST /api/terminals/:id/merge-project` and `POST /api/projects/:id/worktrees/:wid/merge-project` → 200 `{ merged: true, fastForward }`. The commit `gm: project files from <title>` lands in the project folder's branch. - [ ] On a conflict → 409 `{ error: "merge conflict", files }`, with no merge in progress and a clean project folder. A dirty project folder → 409 `the project folder has uncommitted changes`. - [ ] After a merge, the project repo no longer counts as work when closing. - [ ] The close dialog and the kept project rows offer **Merge project files** when the project repo has work, and show conflicts with the file names. - [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass. ## Validation commands ```bash npm run typecheck && npm run lint npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/terminals.test.ts src/web/pages/Terminals.test.tsx npm test ```
